name: Makimura Hazuki
source:
A freelancer who lives in the next room. She has a withdrawn and negative personality and because of her personality, she thinks that she will never be recognized as a member of the opposite sex, and she doesn't pay much attention to her appearance. However, after she becomes lovers with Akira, she gradually changes.

Influenced by her parents, she is a movie buff, especially when talking about independent films, her eyes sparkle. Her love for movies has grown so much that she has been shooting her own independent films, but even after several years, she has yet to complete them.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1138957]Getchu[/url]]
